Lumineon

Water

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Lumineon is a Water-type Neon Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 24 kg. It evolves from Finneon. Its highest base stat is Speed (91), with a base stat total of 460.
